selection: Every three-column trace passing interval, strict monotonic time/temperature, ramp and endpoint screens; no energy-based selection
model: Single normalized-coverage first-order PW state, constant E and prefactor, free scale; optional constant baseline
signal_units: Original numeric detector units retained; header identifies mass 124.22 and E-11 scale, physical current unit not explicit
coordinate_units: K and seconds inferred from numeric ranges, channel names and agreement with published 1 K/s; file header does not spell units out
reference_quantity: Zero-coverage extrapolation of coverage-dependent complete analysis, not a fixed-E whole-trace estimate
acceptance: No reference-energy pass/fail: coverage labels and comparable analysis unresolved; exploratory acquisition and conditional fit study only
